title: My Data Company
excerpt: My first interview at My Data company was the worst experience I've ever had, with a ****  boss and no professional ethics.

blocks.text: My first interview experience in life was with this company. I was a 21-22 year old young man who wanted to work while studying for my bachelor's. I asked one of my professors at Azad University of Isfahan to introduce me if he knew a place, and this company was introduced.
The Interview

I don't remember how we arranged it, but one day we arranged with that same professor who worked in that company and went to see him. Our professor's office was next to that company and had a connection with its boss. Anyway, we went and sat outside, and they called us. When we entered the company, it was an interesting place in terms of environment and looked very good.
My interview was with the boss of the company - the owner. I sat down and there was a notebook in front of him and he started asking questions.
How many terms are you in? I'm in term 6.
What have you done, what do you know? I know Python and I'm a Python programmer. I'm also gradually learning Django.
Which university were you in? Azad University of Isfahan!
And suddenly he turned and said,
a garbage useless university!
I said, where did you study? He said, Azad University of Najafabad!
And I had this feeling of, what are you saying really! We both studied at Azad University! What's all this hate and anger for?
Then he said, can you go on military service or not? How many children are you, and stupid questions like that...

After these questions, he turned to me and said, you're starting very late! And I, who had just turned 21-22, was completely surprised! I said, well what should I do? My life and my path is this! There's nothing I can do about it.
He said yes, we have kids who come here and work from 17-18 years old, and he staaaarted to talk about himself and his company...
He said, we'll give you a project, please do this and then send it to us and come for a second interview.
The Project
Their work was in the field of organizational ERP. It didn't really suit me, but well, since my professor had mediated, I decided to do this project too.
They sent the project on Telegram I think, I don't remember exactly, and I was involved with it for several days and did it right on the day we had the deadline and sent it to them on Telegram.
After a few days they called and said come for an interview.
I went and showed the project and explained it, and again that man started asking me questions and I answered him.
And in the end he turned and said it was very weak... I had done all my effort and it was just this much!
I don't remember exactly what conversation we had but it was very very bad.
It was clear that I was facing a complete jerk.
I left the interview session. And I didn't collaborate with them.
Of course, I was inexperienced then and tried to keep that person's respect, but if I wanted to attend that interview with my experience today, I would definitely answer him differently.
My Opinion
My personal experience with this company was the worst experience I could have had. The company boss is very A**H*** , angry, Bas*****, etc.

Years later I saw him at an exhibition and they had a booth and they really weren't doing anything. They also designed some websites for a few famous Isfahan companies, each one worse and more useless than the other.

Also, I should say that I talked to several people who had previously worked at that same company and all their opinions were similar to mine. They were not satisfied at all and all had similar descriptions of this company.
If you want my opinion:

This company is not a place to work at all. There is neither professional ethics nor room for growth. So if you like to lose your nerves and your soul and mind, this company can be a suitable choice for you.
